description: Run a release-driven Paseo engineering organization: the CTO keeps a product clock and critical path, delegates isolated engineering and Claude Design work, and integrates only evidence-reviewed results.

interface.shortDescription: Run a release-driven Paseo engineering organization
interface.longDescription: Operate a CTO-led Paseo fleet in Codex or Claude. The CTO keeps the nearest shippable outcome, critical path, time windows, and depth gate explicit; delegates isolated engineering and Claude Design work; and integrates only after scored review and evidence-based author response.
defaultPrompt: Use $paseo-cto:paseo-cto to advance the nearest shippable product outcome, reconcile the fleet, and keep the living plan current.
